title: English Quest — 星ことばの冒険

design_contract.battle_ui: Compact one-screen battle; no enemy intents; show HP, cooldowns, status icons and short outcome text only.
design_contract.rounds: Alternate ally round and enemy round. Retain the existing English question flow. A question first-try success sets answer_factor=1.0; any retry sets answer_factor=0.5.
design_contract.answer_scaling: Preserve existing engine contract: first-answer success gives100%; retry gives50% attack/defense/magic and meaningful support/status strength. Multiply direct damage, healing, shields, DOT tick power and buff/debuff numerical magnitude exactly once at creation. Setup marker duration and existence may remain binary only where no numerical magnitude exists. Durations should follow existing engine handling rather than override it. Cleanse/dispel/cooldown counts need engine-native deterministic reduced-support handling; recommended fractional progress meters are below. Never rescale existing DOTs on later turns.
design_contract.skill_flow: At the start of each ally round, all living allies have a basic attack or a ready active skill. Player may toggle ready skills before answering. Resolve slots 1→4, making order-based combinations visible. Unselected slots basic-attack. Cooldown ticks down once at the next ally-round start; a cooldown=3 skill used in round1 is next ready round4. Skills replace basic attacks unless explicitly including a damage effect.
design_contract.numbers: atk multipliers use the acting ally atk. max_hp ratios use the target max_hp. flat durations are in enemy rounds. Party effects target living allies only. Minimum positive direct damage/heal/shield is 1 after rounding; health never exceeds max_hp.
design_contract.statuses: One instance of each status per unit; refresh to the greater remaining duration and greater magnitude, never stack duplicates. Shields add to a cap of 40% target max_hp and expire after specified enemy rounds. Stat modifiers cap at ±40%. DOTs tick after enemy actions, shields before damage, heals after damage only when ordered so.
design_contract.elements: fire/water/wind/earth/light/dark are synergy tags, not a hidden rock-paper-scissors damage chart. Region-specific enemy traits disclose any resistance as icons/tooltips before entry.
design_contract.difficulty: Common units remain upgradeable to maximum level and can clear all main-story stages through combinations. High rarity adds flexibility and unusual mechanics, not exclusive mandatory counters.
design_contract.randomness: No critical hits, misses or random status chance in combat. Enemy targeting lowest current-HP percentage; ties by party slot. Taunt redirects single-target attacks. Enemy status/passive info is accessible from an icon without presenting turn-by-turn intents.
design_contract.support_reduction: Recommended if the engine has no equivalent: each active skill keeps a per-effect progress remainder for cleanse/dispel/cooldown_reduce. Add count×answer_factor; apply floor(total) whole units and retain fraction on that skill/effect until next cast in the battle. Thus two wrong-answer uses of count1 equal one correct use, with no RNG. Reset remainders between battles. Show a small half-progress dot where useful. Taunt and setup tags remain guaranteed unless the existing engine has meaningful potency handling. Numerical guard/weaken/DOT/regen/attack_up/thorns magnitude always scales50% on wrong.
design_contract.condition_and_consumption: Resolve effects in listed order. For each effect, evaluate conditions on a snapshot before applying it to any target, including self statuses and living party tag count. Apply an all-target effect to every qualifying target, then consume status on qualifying targets; self:status consumes once after all qualifying targets finish. A skipped effect consumes nothing. Mark/seed/wet consumption never silently removes unrelated status.

effect.power: number: atk multiplier for damage/heal/shield; status-specific magnitude for apply_status
effect.condition: optional object; if false this effect is skipped
effect.consume_status: optional status ID on target or self:status ID; consume after this entire effect
effect.max_hp_ratio: optional target max HP fraction replaces atk-based power
effect.count: cleanse/dispel status count or cooldown reduction amount

status_definitions.wet: Setup marker, no direct effect. Consumed by specified freeze/lightning-style skills only.
status_definitions.seed: Setup marker for wind and earth combinations.
status_definitions.mark: Setup marker for hunters and curse combinations.
status_definitions.burn: DOT: power × source atk per tick; remains physical-independent damage.
status_definitions.poison: DOT: power × source atk per tick; bypasses armor but not shields.
status_definitions.weaken: Enemy atk reduced by power fraction.
status_definitions.armor_break: Enemy armor damage reduction reduced by power percentage points.
status_definitions.attack_up: Ally atk increased by power fraction.
status_definitions.guard: Incoming damage reduced by power fraction.
status_definitions.regen: Heal power × source atk per tick after enemy round.
status_definitions.taunt: Enemy single-target attacks target this unit.
status_definitions.slow: Enemy attack power reduced by power fraction; separate from weaken but combined enemy atk reduction cap is 40%. Does not skip questions or rounds.
status_definitions.focus: Setup marker; consumption provides named skill effects.
status_definitions.thorns: Return power × source atk when taking direct enemy damage, once per enemy attacker per round. Cannot trigger another thorns.
status_definitions.silence: Unit active skill disabled; basic attacks remain available. Maximum 1 enemy round; party cleanse can remove it.
status_definitions.heal_down: Received healing reduced by power fraction, cap 50%.

enemy_runtime.periodic_actions: Use listed skill on rounds divisible by period; otherwise basic-attack lowest current HP percentage ally. period=1 skills every enemy round. Each living enemy acts once. Enemy effects have answer_factor=1; enemy-side healing/buffs interpret all_enemies as own side. cleanse removes debuffs and dispel removes buffs, selected oldest first, ties by status ID. Shields count as one dispellable buff. Cleanse does not remove ordinary healing or damage.
enemy_runtime.traits: Resistance 50 halves DOT tick magnitude, never immunity. Duration minus1 has floor1. Armor is direct damage fractional reduction, capped60%, reduced by armor_break. DOT bypasses armor. Shield damage bonus adds25% only to damage absorbed by shields; any overflow into HP uses normal damage. Single-target damage resistance applies to direct single-target damage only. Regen ticks at enemy-round end. Thorns cannot trigger thorns.
enemy_runtime.caps: No main-story formation has more than four enemies. At most one silence enemy per wave and silence periodicity >=4. Do not combine heal_down and silence in regions1–6. Never combine both burn and poison resistance in one boss. Every wave displays enemy traits in entry preview.

synergies.name: ぬれ→蒸気
synergies.execution: ぬれ役を前、追撃役を後のスロットに置く。同じラウンドで付与して消費。
synergies.counter: ぬれ短縮の敵には同ラウンドで追撃。複数追撃役はぬれを奪い合う。

synergies.name: 火傷→追撃
synergies.execution: 火傷は持続、追撃は非消費。単体ボス向き。
synergies.counter: 火傷半減の敵では直撃・装甲崩し役へ1枠交換。

synergies.name: たね→芽吹き
synergies.execution: たね仲間2体で回復強化。全体たねから全体消費攻撃へ。
synergies.counter: 解除役が来る前に同ラウンド消費。単体種役だけでは全体追撃が成立しない。

synergies.name: しるし→集中攻撃
synergies.execution: 敵の回復役や旗役を指定して倒す。非消費追撃を先、消費追撃を後。
synergies.counter: 取り巻きが多い場合は全体攻撃1枠。しるし解除に対しては同ラウンド攻撃。

synergies.name: 毒→守りきる
synergies.execution: 装甲を毒で無視し、盾と回復で持続ダメージを待つ。
synergies.counter: 毒半減・自己回復には火傷か印追撃へ交換。待つだけでは解除周期に弱い。

synergies.name: 集中→全体突破
synergies.execution: 集中を付けて全体攻撃。待ち時間短縮は最大1/ラウンド/味方で無限回転不可。
synergies.counter: 敵の強化解除の直後に集中を使う。集中消費役が毎回最大火力を出せるわけではない。

synergies.name: おとり→反撃
synergies.execution: おとりと反撃を同時に張り、回復を合わせる。低レア盾役も耐久枠で活躍。
synergies.counter: 全体攻撃はおとりで防げない。敵1体だけなら直接攻撃の方が速い。

synergies.name: 装甲崩し→直接攻撃
synergies.execution: 装甲を崩し、印を付けて追撃。硬い敵に継続攻撃以外の解答を提供。
synergies.counter: 装甲のないむれ敵には全体攻撃と交代。解除される前に火力を合わせる。

progression.starter: Start with ember_mole, dew_slime, beetle-knight, lantern-moth. Own all four immediately, no pull required.
progression.level_formula: hp = round(base_hp × (1 + .075 × (level - 1))); atk = round(base_atk × (1 + .075 × (level - 1))). All rarities share the formula and cap. No rarity ascension stat tax.
progression.upgrade_cost: To advance from level L to L+1 costs 20+5×L coins. Account unlock caps: region1 max10; region3 max20; region6 max35; region9 max50. Loan-level newly acquired units to max(1, account highest level−5) without cost. This prevents roster experimentation grinding.
progression.defeat: No stamina, entry charge, ticket loss or coin loss. Retry immediately; show one short suggestion based on enemy trait and owned counter.
progression.region_tutorials: Introduce one synergy or counter in early stage; middle stages remix it; guardian tests two familiar mechanics. Avoid tutorial popups during question answering.
progression.post_clear: After all60 stages: optional fixed-rule challenge versions with no exclusive units and cosmetic badges only. No endless difficulty scaling required.
progression.party_constraints: No duplicate character IDs in a party. Four saved party presets. Skills unlocked on acquisition. No leader-only multipliers or mandatory same-element mono team.

economy.currency: Tickets and earned coins only. No purchase flow, premium currency, ads, stamina or paid rerolls.
economy.ten_pull_rule: Exactly10 sequential one-ticket rolls; no extra odds, savings or pressure to batch.
economy.within_rarity: Uniform over the permanent characters of that rarity; exact probability shown in collection screen.
economy.repeat_clear: Every3 dungeon clears yields1 ticket via visible persistent stamp counter; no daily cap. Defeat does not add a stamp. First clears also add stamps. No daily login dependency or expiration.
economy.pity: Track consecutive prior pulls below rarity3 (high) and below rarity4 (top). Before a pull, if top>=29 guarantee rarity4. Else if high>=9 guarantee rarity3+ with80% rarity3 /20% rarity4. Else roll base45/35/16/4%. After rarity4 reset both counters; after rarity3 reset high and increment top; after rarity1/2 increment both. Thus no streak of30 pulls can lack rarity4, and no streak of10 can lack rarity3+.

pity_counters.high: number of consecutive prior pulls below rarity3
pity_counters.top: number of consecutive prior pulls below rarity4

economy.duplicate_policy: First copy unlocks full unit. Every duplicate, regardless of rarity, yields1 Memory Leaf. No duplicate stats, limit breaks or skill boosts. This prevents lucky repeat pulls from making low rarities obsolete.
economy.selection_shop: Spend6 Leaves for any missing rarity1,10 for rarity2,18 for rarity3,30 for rarity4. All permanent allies always listed; no rotation. Selectors cannot buy already-owned characters. If all owned, leaves buy cosmetic portrait frames for5; nothing affects strength.
economy.full_roster_backstop: Every40 lifetime pulls grants1 Choice Page, redeemable for any one unowned ally of any rarity. This is in addition to pull results and pity. With36 total units this gives a finite worst-case route to collection completion. Counter persists forever; no expiration.
economy.fairness_ui: Show odds, both pity counters, lifetime page progress and duplicate exchange before pulling. Allow skip animation and10-at-once. No near-miss, countdown, limited banner or loss-framed messaging.
economy.save_atomicity: Ticket debit, RNG outcome, pity changes, owned roster, duplicate currency and lifetime counter commit atomically before animation. Interrupted animation can replay its saved result but never charge again.
economy.rng_testing: Inject seedable RNG for tests; production use browser crypto or existing reliable RNG. Do not alter odds based on engagement, payment, retries, question accuracy or roster.
economy.ticket_budget: 60 first clears give84 tickets (48 normal +12 bosses×3), plus5 start tickets and20 stamp tickets from first clears=109 pulls before replay grinding. At least2 Choice Pages by then. Guaranteed unit rewards do not consume pulls or reset pity.
economy.clear_reward_atomicity: Each battle gets a unique persisted run_id. Successful clear transaction atomically marks run_id rewarded, sets firstClear[dungeon_id] only if absent, adds first-clear tickets only once, adds exactly1 repeat stamp for this unique run, issues1 ticket per3 stamps with remainder, grants coins and any guaranteed unit. Reopened victory screens and double clicks cannot repeat rewards. Defeat never commits clear rewards. Save transaction before reward animation.

acceptance_tests: 36 unique ally IDs; rarity counts12/12/8/4. 40 enemy archetypes. 12 regions and60 unique dungeon IDs. All references resolve.
No money/payment/ad/stamina references in UX or code pathways.

First-answer correct and retry skill outcomes differ by one factor for all numerical effects, including delayed DOTs and guard/buff magnitudes. Verify deterministic reduced-support count handling with engine contract; never double-scale.
Slot1 wet, slot2 steam deals bonus; reversed slots do not unless wet persisted from earlier round. Consume only the matching status on the matching target.
All-enemy conditional effects evaluate separately for each target. Conditional heal evaluates each ally. party_tag_count counts living party members including actor.

A cooldown3 skill used round1 is available again round4; reduction never drops below0; reduce counts max1 per recipient per ally round and excludes actor. No active skill may cast more than once per round.
At 29 prior non-rarity4 pulls, next result is rarity4. At9 prior sub-rarity3 pulls absent top pity, next is rarity3+. Both counters persist reload.
Duplicate conversion is equal for every rarity and never modifies unit battle strength. Starter/quest guaranteed units already owned convert to1 Leaf.
One-pull and ten-pull use the same sequential probability and pity function. Counters and rewards commit once on refresh interruption.

All main-story stages must be playtested using only starter + guaranteed reward roster, at listed recommended level, with 70% first-answer success and sensible skill timing. If impossible, lower enemy stats; do not increase gacha dependency.

Target ordinary battle completion3–6 ally rounds per wave, boss6–10. Count UI actions and keep enemy outcomes in a short aggregated line. Full-party wipe loses; all enemies dead wins before their turn.
Original Japanese names and text require no references to commercial games or their assets.

Clear a new dungeon, refresh victory screen, and double-click confirm: first-clear tickets, guaranteed unit and stamp must each award once only. Repeat as a new run adds only repeat coins and1 stamp. Simulate crash before/after commit; no partial state or double rewards.

Counter exactness is tested at high=8/9 and top=28/29 including simultaneous guarantees, ten-pull boundaries, saves, and duplicate results. A promised guarantee must never reset on reload, banner choice, or region clear.
integration_note: This is original content and balance data, not a demand to replace established battle timing, question flow, or support-effect semantics. Adapt IDs/effects to current engine while preserving listed roles and the100%/50% requirement. HP/ATK are initial tuning values requiring simulation; collection counts and reference integrity are verified, difficulty is not yet playtested.
